task.language: push the plate to the front of the stove

prohibitions: No 216-branch dataset before A3 and B pass
No replay branch reported as a task outcome
No simulator action before protocol and tests are present

R1.snapshots: 2-3 preregistered stable-contact snapshots with positive/negative XY action headroom
R1.residual_grid: symmetric and derived per snapshot so abs(nominal_xy+residual_xy)<1 with explicit margin
R1.inference: fixed saved nominal action; none in branches
R1.measurement: raw robot-on-plate MuJoCo sum after env.step(executed), with pre-action sum separately retained
R1.pass: predicted signed monotonic increments at >=2 snapshots; no clipping/contact loss; independently reconstructed raw sums
R1.failure: stop; OSC normalized action channel falsified for this claim

R2.entry: only if R1 attributes V2 failure to saturation/state drift
R2.implementation: namespace-local reversible OSC adapter below normalized action interface
R2.pass: aligned force ordered, contact retained, no dominant actuator saturation

A3.controller: frozen bounded P/PI using previous completed step force, EMA, ramp and anti-windup
A3.targets: three empirical-range Newton targets plus no-feedback
A3.tracking: paired root-0 mu=1.2 short trials, ordered force and lower error than no-feedback
A3.outcome: <=6 online full-task branches; root 0 then root 1 replication; exact prefix parity
A3.pass: tracking pass plus >=1 same-root force-dependent native recovery/feasibility
